name: AquaPure: strong El Niño heading into summer 2027
note: illustrative signals for a demonstration. The ENSO status mirrors the NOAA CPC discussion of 12 Nov 2026; weather values and all articles are invented for the scenario

el_nino.summary: NOAA CPC ENSO discussion issued 2026-11-12: status 'El Niño Advisory'. El Niño continues to strengthen, with a strong-to-very strong El Niño likely through January-March 2027 (remaining greater than a 79% chance).

articles.title: [Scenario] IMD expects a warmer-than-normal pre-monsoon season as strong El Niño persists
articles.snippet: Above-normal temperatures are likely over central and western India from March to May 2027, with more heatwave days than usual in Maharashtra and Gujarat.

articles.title: [Scenario] Strong El Niño raises the risk of a weak 2027 monsoon, say forecasters
articles.snippet: Past strong El Niño years were often followed by below-normal monsoon rainfall, although the Indian Ocean Dipole can offset part of the effect.

pune_weather.summary: Pune and Western Maharashtra seasonal outlook (scenario values; ECMWF SEAS5 mean, regional, not bias-corrected; normal = 10-yr archive): 2026-11: 24.4°C (+0.5 vs normal), rain 9 mm vs normal 14 mm; 2026-12: 22.9°C (+0.6 vs normal), rain 3 mm vs normal 4 mm; 2027-01: 22.6°C (+0.7 vs normal), rain 1 mm vs normal 2 mm; 2027-02: 25.1°C (+0.9 vs normal), rain 0 mm vs normal 1 mm; 2027-03: 29.0°C (+1.2 vs normal), rain 1 mm vs normal 3 mm; 2027-04: 31.6°C (+1.4 vs normal), rain 3 mm vs normal 8 mm

articles.title: [Scenario] Maharashtra districts start heat action plans early for summer 2027
articles.snippet: Officials cited the El Niño outlook and asked municipalities to prepare drinking-water kiosks from March.

articles.title: [Scenario] PET resin prices in India rise about 8% on firmer crude and tight supply
articles.snippet: Converters said domestic PET resin prices rose about 8% in November and may stay high through the first quarter of 2027.

articles.title: [Scenario] Tanker attacks in a key shipping lane push Brent crude up 6% in a week
articles.snippet: Freight and insurance costs rose as some tankers rerouted; analysts expect higher prices for oil-based plastics if disruption lasts.

articles.title: [Scenario] Draft rule proposes higher recycled content in PET bottles from 2028
articles.snippet: The proposal is open for comments until February 2027 and would apply from April 2028.
